blocks.text: Washington, United States—Democrats won the US House of Representatives Tuesday and closed in on control of the Senate after a stunning victory in deeply conservative Texas, inflicting a sweeping midterm defeat on President Donald Trump’s Republicans. A fourth Republican Senate seat fell to Democrats in Ohio, where former senator Sherrod Brown won his comeback bid. The party has now gained the four seats needed to overturn the Republicans’ 53-47 majority, provided it holds all its own seats — some of which remain uncalled. The election amounted to a nationwide rebuke of Trump’s turbulent second term, driven by anger over living costs, tariffs […]... Keep on reading: Democrats seize US House, near Senate takeover
